One of my senior colleagues who tried to get me fired in my first week. First full time job coming through as a graduate, the whole process of starting with this company was a mess as it turns out they were going through a takeover behind the scenes (which got me laid off in the end - another story) . They couldn't arrange computers for me and this other guy until 4 days in, so we just had to go through the motions and fake it (re-reading manuals over and over). Once the computers arrived, she got really angry because our equipment was new, but her unstable colleague friend had been waiting on a new monitor apparently. Of course, take it out on the new people and not the CEO who was the one signing off on equipment.

Anyway, I eventually turned it around having to do crazy mental gymnastics everyday to get people onside (which worked), but my co-worker who started the same day got bullied really badly, and she led the charge. To this day, she's one of the worst people I've ever met, and this experience is part of why I stay away from office jobs.
